summary: Role meta dependencies, setup aliases and symlinks are discovered automatically, while needs/target/TARGET and needs/file/PATH declare other dependencies.
questions: How do I declare that my test depends on another target?

answer_card.title: Dependency aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
Auto-discovered: `meta/main.yml` role deps, `setup/*` aliases, symlinks into other targets. Otherwise declare:
- `needs/target/TARGET`
- `needs/file/PATH` (relative to Git root)
